_comment: Claude Code backend follow-up for W4 Quick Export real backend support. This is implementation work, not review-only work.
title: Implement backend support for Quick Export column_overrides and null-template export flow
objective: Implement the missing backend support so Quick Export can use the real export pipeline instead of the current frontend-only CSV fallback. This specifically means supporting template_id = null together with column_overrides for preview/export flows, aligned with the frozen W4 export design.

background.current_frontend_state: The production-facing export UI on src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html now supports Quick Export and Template Export with inline column adjustment. However, Quick Export currently falls back to client-side CSV because the backend does not yet support template_id:null plus column_overrides.
background.why_this_matters: The frozen W4 design expects Quick Export to be a real path in the export pipeline, not a demo-only or client-only fallback. This backend gap is the main remaining mismatch between the current frontend pass and the frozen W4 export spec.

required_behavior: Quick Export must work without selecting a template.
Quick Export must accept user-adjusted columns for the current run.
The backend must support template_id = null together with column_overrides for preview/export behavior.
Template Export behavior must keep working and must not regress.
The implementation must stay aligned with the frozen W4 acceptance wording, especially ac_1006_r2 through ac_1006_r7.
what_to_build: 1. Extend the export request contract so template_id may be null when the caller provides a valid column_overrides array for Quick Export.
2. Support preview generation for the null-template path using column_overrides as the effective export definition.
3. Support export generation for the null-template path using column_overrides as the effective export definition.
4. Ensure encoding/format handling is consistent with the canonical enum and existing export behavior.
5. Keep balance validation behavior intact for the real export flow.
6. Add or update focused backend/API tests for the new Quick Export path.
7. If any frontend contract assumption must change, document it explicitly in the implementation report instead of making silent breaking changes.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/export/preview accepts a Quick Export-style request with template_id:null plus column_overrides and returns a valid preview payload.
POST /api/v1/export accepts a Quick Export-style request with template_id:null plus column_overrides and returns a valid file response.
Template-based export behavior still works after the change.
Balance validation still blocks invalid exports where required.
Focused tests cover the null-template Quick Export path and pass.
The implementation report clearly states what was changed and any remaining backend/frontend gap.

report_sections: What still remains outside this task

final_instruction_to_claude: Implement the backend follow-up. Do not answer with a plan-only or review-only summary. If the change cannot be completed safely, return the exact blocker and the exact missing contract or dependency.
